title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 250 ]

blocks.text: Suppose a company realizes that it is not achieving its goals or objectives effectively. In this case, it can be useful to get an outside consultant to analyze the company’s performance and recommend changes to make it more efficient. This consultant can more objectively analyze the company’s strengths and weaknesses as well as the opportunities and threats that face it. Then the company can re-plan its strategy on the basis of the consultant’s advice. In this way, the company will be able to get its intended results

readingSentences.english: Suppose a company realizes that it is not achieving its goals or objectives effectively.
readingSentences.korean: 어떤 회사가 목표나 목적을 효과적으로 달성하지 못하고 있다는 것을 깨닫는다고 가정해 보자.

readingSentences.english: In this case, it can be useful to get an outside consultant to analyze the company’s performance and recommend changes to make it more efficient.
readingSentences.korean: 이러한 경우에, 외부 컨설턴트를 고용하여 회사의 능력을 분석하고, 회사가 보다 더 효율적으로 되도록 변화를 권고하도록 하는 것은 유익할 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: This consultant can more objectively analyze the company’s strengths and weaknesses as well as the opportunities and threats that face it.
readingSentences.korean: 이런 컨설턴트는 회사가 직면하고 있는 기회와 위협 뿐만아니라 회사의 강점과 약점도 보다 더 객관적으로 분석할 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: Then the company can re-plan its strategy on the basis of the consultant’s advice.
readingSentences.korean: 그러면, 그 회사는 컨설턴트의 조언에 근거하여 회사의 전략을 다시 세울 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: In this way, the company will be able to get its intended results
readingSentences.korean: 이렇게 해서, 그 회사는 의도한 결과를 얻어낼 수 있을 것이다.
